name: CQUESTwithBruker-preproc-batch
author: Hélène RATINEY / Denis Grenier / Théotime Ferh--Delude
description: Preprocessing pipeline for spectroscopy signals acquired on a Brucker MRI followed by cQuest MR spectrosocpy signal quantification software.
command-line: unzip -j [ZIP_BASIS] -d basis && met=$(find basis -name Cr* -print -quit); : "${met:?Creatine metabolite not found}" && mkdir -p ROOT_DATA_DIR && case [DATA_FILE] in *.tar) tar -C ROOT_DATA_DIR -xf [DATA_FILE] ;; *.tar.gz | *.tgz) tar -C ROOT_DATA_DIR -xzf [DATA_FILE] ;; *.zip) unzip [DATA_FILE] -d ROOT_DATA_DIR ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac && find ROOT_DATA_DIR -type f -name 'acqp' -exec grep -zrlP '##\$ACQ_dim_desc=\( 1 \)\nSpectroscopic' {} + | while IFS= read -r f; do d=$(dirname "$f") && python3 /bruker-spectro-processing-pipeline/vip_prepro.py --fid "$d"/fid --acqp "$d"/acqp --method "$d"/method --refscan "$d"/fid.refscan --rawjob0 "$d"/rawdata.job0 --metabolite "$met" [PPM_R] [PPM_A] [NOISE_R] [DISPLAY_R] [MEAN_LW] [STDEV_LW] [STDEV_FR] [MV_AV] --outname [OUTNAME] --outpath "$d/" && bash /run_cquest.sh [PARAM_FILE] "$d/[OUTNAME]RecPastis.mrui" basis "$d/[OUTNAME]RecBruker.mrui" && python3 /plot_cquest_result.py -i ROOT_DATA_DIR -m basis ; done && find ROOT_DATA_DIR -type f -name "[OUTNAME]*" -print0 | tar --null --files-from=- --transform="s#^ROOT_DATA_DIR/##" -czf [OUT_FILE] && rm -rf basis && rm -rf ROOT_DATA_DIR

inputs.name: Archived rat data
inputs.description: Archive of rat data in the tar format (e.g 'rat.tar') containing directories of each day containing several acquisition raw files ('fid' 'acqp' 'method' 'fid.refscan' 'rawdata.job0')

inputs.name: Parameter text file for cQuest
inputs.description: File setting up constraints, options and prior knowledge used in cQuest algorithm

inputs.name: Zipped data base folder
inputs.description: Archive containing all metabolite & macromolecules in .mrui format

inputs.name: ppm_r
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format {start}_{end} . frequency region in ppm on which phasing operations are focused.

inputs.name: ppm_a
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format {start}_{end} . frequency region in ppm on which SNR and LW analysis are performed (NAA peak).

inputs.name: noise_r
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format {start}_{end} . frequency region in ppm on which noise level is estimated

inputs.name: display_r
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format {start}_{end} . frequency region in ppm used to display the spectra

inputs.name: mean_lw_Hz
inputs.description: Mean linewidth considered as good linewidth for further analysis (Hz)

inputs.name: stdev_lw_Hz
inputs.description: acceptable standard deviation around the mean linewidth (Hz)

inputs.name: stdev_fr_ppm
inputs.description: acceptable standard deviation/amplitude of the frequency fluctuation/drift in ppm

inputs.name: mv_av
inputs.description: number of spectra in a moving average used in the analyze and reject procedure

output-files.description: A tarball containing all result files of each day
output-files.name: Output file
